answer: A farm of 308 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in wander, queued in glacier, and quill publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 74 identities per epoch. A farm of 1092 identities would post 4220 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
